scenario_title: Parcel handling across six distribution sites in three regions, Jan-Jun 2024
data_context: The network operations group pulled one record per outbound shift from six distribution sites for the first half of 2024, while a new night-shift roster was being trialled.
script:
dim("region", ["North", "South", "West"], weights=[0.40, 0.35, 0.25], group="network")
dim("site", ["Aurora", "Brookfield", "Calder", "Dunmore", "Eastgate", "Fairmont"],
    parent="region", group="network",
    weights={"North": [0.55, 0.45, 0, 0, 0, 0],
             "South": [0, 0, 0.50, 0.50, 0, 0],
             "West":  [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.60, 0.40]})
dim("shift", ["Morning", "Afternoon", "Night"], weights=[0.40, 0.40, 0.20],
    ordered="ordinal", group="schedule")

time("ship_date", start="2024-01-01", end="2024-06-30", freq="daily")

measure("parcels",
        "poisson(lam = 120 + 40*[shift=Morning] - 30*[shift=Night] + 25*[region=North])",
        unit="units", additive=True)
measure("handling_cost",
        "parcels * 1.8 + {Morning: 240, Afternoon: 190, Night: 320}[shift] + gaussian(0, 45)",
        unit="USD", additive=True)
measure("on_time_rate",
        "clip(0.97 - parcels / 4200 - 0.05*[shift=Night] + gaussian(0, 0.02), 0, 1)",
        unit="rate", additive=False)

emit(1600)

intents.sentence: Which site handles the most parcels
How handling cost moved through the half year
